{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2011}}
{{main|2011 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2011 World Table Tennis Championships women's doubles''' was the 50th edition of the women's doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Tennis}}</ref><ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-04-12|title=Women's doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123|access-date=2018-03-21|archive-date=2018-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180922055935/http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> [[Guo Yue (table tennis)|Guo Yue]] and [[Li Xiaoxia]] won the title in 2009. They successfully defended their title by defeating [[Ding Ning]] and [[Guo Yan]] in the final 11–8, 11–5, 13–11, 11–8.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24341&Competition_ID=1962& |title=Guo Yue and Li Xiaoxia Retain Title in Style in Ahoy Arena |date=2011-05-15 |work=ittf.com |accessdate=2011-05-19 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120819225427/http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24341&Competition_ID=1962& |archivedate=2012-08-19 }}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches will be best of 5 games in qualification matches and best of 7 games in the 64-player sized main draw.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |title=2011 World TT Championships Playing System |publisher=ITTF |format=PDF |accessdate=8 May 2011 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110322194848/http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |archivedate=22 March 2011 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=1962&Seeded_Doubles=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& |title=2011 WTTC Seeds – Women's doubles |work=ittf.com |accessdate=8 May 2011}}</ref>
